source: Supplied four-contract, thirteen-invoice dataset; source-note interpretations must be labelled as assumptions.

questions.question: List all four contracts with customer, currency, cadence, start date, entitlements, and amendment relationships.
How many invoices and credit memos exist? Separate invoices linked to a plan from orphan invoices.
Show gross invoiced totals by original currency, without mixing EUR and USD.
Which apparent billing gaps are supported by source facts and which require assumptions?
Summarize the stated 12-month monthly agreement for C-1001 and derive its proposed full contract end.
List every existing invoice for C-1001 in issue-date order. Do not invent any invoice IDs.
Which issue month is missing between the observed invoices for C-1001? Distinguish issue dates from confirmed service periods.
What is the suggested September 2025 correction for C-1001 if USD 8,000 per month and issue-month service allocation are reviewed assumptions?
What are the gross invoiced, paid, and unpaid totals for C-1001? Explain whether unpaid invoices count as billed.
Is unpaid invoice I-9010 a missing invoice or a collections issue?
Why should a September-only review use a service period or audit cutoff separately from the full 12-month contract end?
Do monthly Analytics invoice descriptions establish that Support was fully billed? Identify the evidence needed.
Explain the relationship between C-1007 and C-1007-A1 and when the amendment takes effect.
Can the original C-1007 terms be used to price service after 1 July 2025? Explain the amendment boundary.
What can and cannot be concluded about USD 20,000 invoice I-9110 without confirmed quarterly service periods and pricing?
Compare the currency of invoice I-9123 with the currency and stated quarterly target of C-1007-A1.
Using the exact 12 September 2025 EUR-to-USD rate, what is EUR 25,000 in USD?
After applying the existing USD 2,000 credit M-300 to I-9123, what is its net billed value in USD?
Does the existing M-300 credit already offset the apparent FX overbilling against the stated USD 25,000 quarterly target? State the assumptions.
Would another USD 2,000 credit on I-9123 duplicate an existing adjustment?
Summarize C-1010 and invoice I-9201, including the annual start-date anchor and entitlements.
Compare the USD 120,000 contract total with the USD 100,000 invoice. Is USD 20,000 a confirmed shortfall or a candidate requiring coverage and pricing validation?
Does the description Annual base plan prove Analytics and Consulting are both covered? What is missing?
Should the annual service period for C-1010 be anchored to 15 January or to the calendar year?
Which invoice has no plan reference, and what amount, customer and issue date does it show?
Can I-9202 be assigned to C-1007-A1 solely because the customer is Globex? What evidence would confirm its allocation?
Which exact FX rates are supplied? What should happen if a required date or currency pair has no rate?
What should a September C-1001 proposal show before approval: amount, service period, assumptions, source references, and expected effect?
What is the difference between a saved draft needing details and a validated proposal awaiting approval?
How can a user approve, reject, verify, and roll back a proposal? Explain only; do not perform any action.
